title: Torsion of every finite order in the homology of graph braid groups
summary: We determine the torsion subgroup of $H_{m-1}(\mathbb{B}_mK_{m+1,m+r-1};\mathbb{Z})$ for $m\ge2$ and $r\ge0$: top homology with arbitrary coefficients is the kernel of an unsigned subset-inclusion matrix, and its integral diagonal form determines all primary summands. Every finite order occurs, with explicit representatives. Generalized theta classes span an embedded copy of the cokernel of the inclusion matrix, containing all torsion; for $r\ge m$ they generate the torsion, each of order $\operatorname{lcm}(1,\ldots,m)$.
